title: Cubone 50/64 Jungle 1st Edition Pokemon 1999 WOTC Mitsuhiro Arita Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Cubone – Pokemon Jungle – 50/64 – 1st EDITION
You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.
Card details
Name: Cubone (Basic Pokemon, Fighting)
40 HP
Set: Jungle (1999)
Card number: 50/64
Edition: 1st Edition – the 1st Edition stamp is visible on the left side below the artwork
Rarity: Common
Illustrator: Mitsuhiro Arita
Pokedex: LV. 13, #104
Copyright: © 1995, 96, 98 Nintendo, Creatures, GAMEFREAK. © 1999 Wizards
Flavor text: Lonely Pokemon. Length: 1' 4", Weight: 14 lbs. Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokemon's real face.
Attacks
Snivel (Colorless) – If the Defending Pokemon attacks Cubone during your opponent's next turn, any damage done by the attack is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching either Pokemon ends this effect.)
Rage (Fighting, Fighting) – 10+ damage. Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Cubone.
Weakness: Grass. Resistance: Lightning -30. Retreat cost: 1.
Note for collectors: this is a 1st Edition print from the original Wizards of the Coast era. Jungle was the second English Pokemon set, released in 1999, and 1st Edition copies carry the small "EDITION 1" stamp rather than the unstamped Unlimited printing.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly.
